Subject: Runtime 2.0: initial rollout checklist for cross-functional review

Team —

Thanks for joining the sync this morning. As discussed, I'm circulating a first-pass rollout checklist for Runtime 2.0 so we can surface any gaps before I take this to the exec update on Monday. The attached spreadsheet breaks the plan into: docs/enablement, rollout gates, infra runbooks, customer communications, and post-launch metrics.

Key asks from each function (short):
- Product (Vivek): confirm default canary percentage and fallback policy (we need these for the runbook).
- Docs/Enablement (Laura): gap list & estimated hours for required KB and quickstarts.
- Sales & CS (Aditya, Monica): any top-10 customers who must be pinned to old runtime at launch? We should prepare comms.
- Eng (Priyom): finalize the emergency rollback steps and the precise alerts to O11y.

Please add comments in the sheet by EOD Thursday (2026-05-13). If there are any non-negotiable blockers, flag them separately in-line so we can escalate.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runtime2-rollout-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet summary)

Marissa —

Reading the checklist. Quick answers inline:
- Canary: propose 5% initial canary in US region for 48 hours, then 25% for 3 days if error and latency SLOs stable. Will pin the final numbers in the runbook.
- Fallback policy: automated fallback to Runtime 1.9 variant when the 95p latency breaches 150ms or error rate > 1.5%. We need SRE to own the automation.

One product ask: we should have an explicit API-deprecation note if any downstream behaviour changes (even minor). Laura — can you flag where that goes in the KB?

Vivek
VP Product

I reviewed the spreadsheet and sketched a prioritized doc plan. High level:
- Quickstart guide: required (approx 8 hrs writing + 4 hrs review + 2 hrs QA).
- API changes / deprecation note: short blast & changelog entry (2 hrs).
- Migration notes for customers pinned to 1.9: one-pager + recommended config examples (6 hrs).
- Enablement slide deck: draft ready; need product sign-off on canary numbers.

Two gaps:
1) We do not have a decision on whether the new metrics names are final. If names change after KB is published we will need rapid updates — recommend a feature flag in docs to mark "beta metric names".
2) We need an engineers-to-docs review window (48 hours) immediately after the runbook is finalized.

I'll add detailed estimates in the Confluence page by EOD.

Laura Bennett

FW: draft of the deployment-runbook.md - please review

Marissa — attaching the draft runbook (also copied into the repo). Highlights:
- Rollback is a three-step process: (1) disable canary routing; (2) scale down runtime2 pods; (3) switch traffic to 1.9 variant and run post-rollback checks.
- Alerting thresholds: latency p95 > 150ms for 10m OR 5xx rate > 1% for 5m triggers immediate page.
- Manual approval gate at 25% expansion if any automated alerts fired during the 5% period.

Open items I need from others:
- Laura: confirm where to point customers for migration examples.
- Aditya/Monica: confirm customer pin list and how we communicate.
- Vivek: sign-off on exact alert numbers and whether Automation team will build the fallback playbook.

Priyom
Staff Engineer, Runtime

Attachment: deployment-runbook.md
